description: This file defines a Java interface named HealthCheckServer within the org.eclipse.hono.service package. The interface provides a method to register health check resources for a service, focusing on server-side health monitoring functionalities.

classes.name: HealthCheckServer
classes.description: A Java interface that provides server health check registration capabilities. It extends the Lifecycle interface and includes a method to register health check resources for a service.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckResources
methods.description: A method to register readiness and liveness health checks for a specific service instance implementing HealthCheckProvider.
